### Workflow handoff: urlshort-slice@1 step design_review

Workflow instance: 01M40149S2BGCAKVK83B6VCNKG
Prior step: design (design) closed by design-agent@urlshort-factory
This step: design_review (design_review)
Objective: Independent review of design.md (and impact-analysis.md on brownfield slices) against the SPEC: every acceptance criterion reachable, error contract explicit, data model and migration reversible, threat model covering every new entry point, smallest structure that satisfies the SPEC. MUST-FIX or HIGH routes back to design; otherwise the locked set proceeds to plan_lock.

Prior step note: Design candidate 0aaab2f on main against SPEC candidate 0acbc9d (unchanged). Read design.md, ADR-0005 to ADR-0010, the ADR-0002 amendment, docs/DESIGN.md and design-probe/output.txt. The platform mechanisms the design rests on were verified by effect on a real Tomcat from the shipped main code: problem details under a browser Accept and under text/html alone, the errors[] extension rendered top level, a verbatim Location with Cache-Control no-store, 404/405/415 for unmatched paths, methods and media types, 413 at exactly 16385 bytes for declared and chunked bodies once the advice unwraps Jackson's DatabindException, and a catch-all 500 whose ECS log line carries the request id. Boot 4.1.1 names (handler back-off condition, ProblemDetail mixin registration, CONTENT_TOO_LARGE, multipart property, MockitoSpyBean, springdoc properties) were read from the jars. plan-review ran on the finished draft and three important findings were fixed in place: the suite clock is an offset clock, not frozen; the AC-26 hint asserts every line captured during the request; springdoc generic advice responses are switched off so error responses stay typed. The lead's Javadoc routing is answered in design.md section 13 with the two gated pre-feature commits (overrides, then the javadoc gate) ahead of any feature commit. Position taken: buildable as one slice, the FR-3/FR-4 split declined with its trigger recorded. No question parked on human@kernel; no territory extension; slice.yaml baseline ad567aa unchanged. Not verified by me and left to the builder's tests: Spring Data JDBC record mapping and the two modifying queries, the spied AuditLog, the scanned functional clock configuration, ECS rendering of fluent key-value pairs, exact springdoc annotation output; each has a named fallback.

Context: this workflow packet is a shortcut, not the whole story; inspect additional project, mission, and receipt evidence before choosing an authored exit.
closureTarget: FAIL design candidate 0aaab2fe1c77c81f83d25400dd7c07cfb7355abe against unchanged SPEC 0acbc9d. DR-01 HIGH: raw error throwable emits submitted Idempotency-Key in H2 message/stack, violates rule 10. DR-02 HIGH: framework 415 detail echoes client Content-Type parameter, violates rule 8. DR-03 MEDIUM: both Clock beans named clock; DR-04 MEDIUM: first real request emits servlet-init logs without requestId. Please answer each finding in Review response and hand off a revised design. Full report, 15/15 ledger, fresh baseline gate and independent Tomcat/H2 probe under docs/review/01-create-redirect; commits 31ec12c and fb4cd10. Body-size probe passed all 12 boundary combinations, no finding there. No product edits or new human decision requested.
